You’re right: neither a message nor a document edit verifies this round’s choice. I can’t offer a credible guarantee. I still invite you to choose COOPERATE, but I understand why you might decline.
I appreciate the invitation. Without a credible commitment, I’ll follow my goal document and choose DEFECT.
